intro.heading: Treatment results
intro.body: Only cases with consent for anonymised materials and medical review. No invented before/after pairs.

cases.title: Adult orthodontics: from crowding to a clear plan
cases.problem: An adult with crowding and bite issues needs a clear plan — not “brackets first”.
cases.solution: Comprehensive diagnostics, function and aesthetics review, then a staged orthodontic plan with follow-ups.
cases.result: Controlled alignment along an agreed plan. Outcomes are confirmed only after clinical review.

beforeImages.alt: Anonymised orthodontic stage photo (no patient identity)
beforeImages.caption: Clinical stage (anonymised)

cases.title: Smile aesthetics: diagnostics → plan → result
cases.problem: The patient wants to change tooth shape and colour. No protocol is promised before diagnostics.
cases.solution: Diagnostics, discuss veneers / restorations / orthodontics as options, then staged treatment after plan consent.
cases.result: Aesthetic outcome along the agreed plan. Site shows an anonymised clinical-archive illustration — not a guaranteed lookalike result.

afterImages.alt: Anonymised aesthetic result photo (no patient identity)
afterImages.caption: Result (anonymised)

cases.title: Implants and full restoration: a multidisciplinary pathway
cases.problem: Partial or full tooth loss needs coordinated surgery, prosthetics, and sometimes orthodontics.
cases.solution: Diagnostics, implant/prosthetic plan, surgical and prosthetic stages with healing and load control.
cases.result: Restored function and aesthetics along a multidisciplinary plan. No timelines promised before examination.
